task.name: Models this project validated are reachable only from project configuration, so a consumer starting from shipped defaults does not get them
task.story_text:
## Why

The shipped model catalog now loads from data, and adding a model to it no longer requires a
release. The catalog's contents were migrated faithfully from the previous hardcoded set, which was
the right scope for that change — but it means the catalog reflects what was hardcoded historically
rather than what this project has since validated and run.

Three models this project routes to daily exist only as project-level declarations: a strong-tier
OpenAI entry, a Google entry adopted after its predecessor was benched, and an Anthropic cheap-tier
entry. Each was chosen deliberately, each has run in production sprints, and each is reachable only
by a consumer who declares it themselves. A repository installing this project and enabling the
shipped defaults gets a catalog whose newest OpenAI tier is a generation behind what this project
runs, and no cheap-tier Anthropic option at all — despite that model already being billed inside
invocations as a component.

The declarations already exist and already carry their routing policy and cost seeds. What is
missing is that they live in the consumer-invisible half of the configuration.

## Acceptance criteria

- A repository that installs this project and enables the shipped defaults resolves the models this
  project routes to, without declaring any of them itself.
- A model that has been validated for general use is reachable from the shipped catalog rather than
  only from a project-level declaration.
- Each promoted entry carries the routing policy and cost seeds it was validated under, so
  promotion moves a definition rather than restating it from memory.
- Where the same canonical identity is defined both in the shipped catalog and in project
  configuration, resolution states which source supplies each field and which one wins. A duplicate
  declaration is not assumed to be inert: pricing attribution differs by source, and attribution
  participates in routing, so the resolved entry must record where its figures came from.
- An operator who removes a duplicate declaration gets the same routing behaviour as one who keeps
  it, or the difference is reported rather than silent.
- This change does not modify the project's own configuration file. Removing the now-redundant
  declarations is separate operator work, sequenced after a release containing these catalog entries
  has been deployed — the process that runs sprints reads an installed release, and a configuration
  that drops its declarations before that release exists would reference models the deployed catalog
  cannot resolve, failing config load and preventing any sprint from starting.
- A model whose identifier has not been confirmed against its provider is not added, so the catalog
  does not acquire entries that fail at dispatch.

## Example

What the two halves contain today:

```
shipped catalog        anthropic/sonnet/cli   anthropic/opus/cli
(data/models.yaml)     openai/gpt-5.4/cli     openai/gpt-5.4-mini/cli   ...

project-only           openai/gpt-5.5/cli            strong tier, in daily use
(forge.yaml)           google/gemini-3.5-flash/api   adopted after its predecessor was benched
                       anthropic/haiku/cli           cheap tier; already billed as a component model
```

After promotion the second group is reachable from the first, and the project's own configuration
drops roughly twenty-six lines of declaration that exist only to restate them.

soft: Coordinator is pure Python — no LLM calls for routing or process decisions
Schema validation is the integrity boundary — do not relax cross-validation rules
Keep modules single-purpose; extract instead of growing monolith files
Keep pure-data types in low-dependency modules with stdlib-only imports
Separate prompt construction, output parsing, and coordinator control flow

When adding or modifying data that flows between coordinator phases, instrument the change so the actual values are visible in the audit trail — diagnosing sprint failures requires tracing real data, not reconstructing it
Do not create files outside src/, tests/, or docs/. If you need a scratch file for exploration, delete it before committing.

Changes that affect coordinator phase boundaries, state handoff between phases, or adaptive routing/config propagation must include seam-level integration tests covering the touched boundary. Unit tests alone are insufficient when correctness depends on cross-phase state flow.
